description:
The "SUPER 30" scheme is an educational initiative launched by the Government of India aimed at providing quality coaching to underprivileged students. 

The scheme was officially launched in 2018. 

It is designed to help talented students from economically weaker sections of society prepare for competitive examinations. 

The primary focus of the SUPER 30 scheme is to facilitate access to quality education for students who may not have the financial means to afford coaching classes. 

The objective of the scheme is to select 30 deserving students each year and provide them with free coaching for the Indian Institutes of Technology Joint Entrance Examination (IIT-JEE). 

The program aims to ensure that these students not only receive coaching but also holistic support including study materials, food, and accommodation. 

The scheme targets students from families with an annual income of less than ₹6 lakh. 

This income criterion is set to ensure that the benefits reach the truly deserving candidates. 

The SUPER 30 program is implemented by the Bihar-based educational organization founded by Anand Kumar. 

Anand Kumar is a mathematician and educator who has gained national recognition for his efforts in helping underprivileged students. 

The selection process for the SUPER 30 scheme involves a rigorous examination and interview process. 

Students are required to demonstrate their academic potential and commitment to their studies. 

The application process begins with an advertisement in local newspapers and educational institutions. 

Interested candidates must fill out an application form which typically requires personal details, educational qualifications, and family income information. 

Candidates must also submit documents such as income certificates, academic records, and identification proof. 

Once the applications are received, a preliminary examination is conducted to shortlist candidates. 

The shortlisted candidates then undergo a personal interview to assess their motivation and suitability for the program. 

The final selection is based on both the examination scores and interview performance. 

Selected students are provided with free coaching for a duration of one year. 

The coaching includes comprehensive training in subjects such as Mathematics, Physics, and Chemistry. 

Students also receive guidance on problem-solving techniques and exam strategies. 

In addition to academic coaching, the program offers mentorship and motivational sessions. 

These sessions are designed to build confidence and resilience among students. 

The SUPER 30 scheme also provides students with free study materials and resources. 

Students are given access to libraries and online resources to enhance their learning experience. 

The program also includes regular assessments to track the progress of students. 

Students are encouraged to participate in mock tests to prepare for the actual examination. 

The scheme has shown significant success since its inception. 

In the first year, out of the 30 students who received coaching, 25 successfully qualified for the IIT-JEE. 

This success rate of approximately 83 percent is a testament to the effectiveness of the program. 

The scheme has expanded its reach to other states in India, including Maharashtra and Uttar Pradesh. 

As of 2023, the SUPER 30 program has coached over 300 students across various batches. 

The initiative has garnered attention from various stakeholders including educational institutions and government bodies. 

The Government of India has recognized the importance of such initiatives in promoting inclusive education. 

The SUPER 30 scheme aligns with the National Education Policy 2020 which emphasizes equitable access to quality education. 

The program is supported by various NGOs and private organizations that contribute resources and expertise. 

The success stories of students from the SUPER 30 scheme have inspired many others to pursue their educational dreams. 

The program has also been featured in various media outlets highlighting its impact on students' lives. 

The contact details for inquiries related to the SUPER 30 scheme can typically be found on the official website of the implementing organization. 

Students and parents interested in the program are encouraged to reach out for more information. 

The scheme is part of a broader effort by the Indian government to enhance educational opportunities for marginalized communities. 

The SUPER 30 initiative exemplifies how targeted support can lead to significant educational outcomes. 

The program not only focuses on academic excellence but also on the overall development of students. 

It aims to create a supportive environment where students can thrive and achieve their goals. 

The SUPER 30 scheme is a model for similar initiatives across the country. 

It highlights the importance of providing equal opportunities for all students regardless of their socio-economic background. 

The program continues to evolve and adapt to the changing educational landscape in India. 

The commitment to quality education remains at the core of the SUPER 30 initiative. 

The scheme has set a benchmark for educational programs aimed at underprivileged students. 

It serves as a reminder of the potential that lies within every student when given the right support and resources. 

The SUPER 30 scheme is a beacon of hope for many aspiring engineers and scientists in India. 

It represents a significant step towards achieving educational equity in the country. 

The impact of the SUPER 30 scheme extends beyond individual success stories. 

It contributes to the larger goal of national development through education and skill-building. 

The program is a testament to the power of education as a tool for social change. 

The SUPER 30 scheme continues to inspire and empower students to reach their full potential. 

It stands as a successful example of how targeted interventions can lead to transformative outcomes in education. 

The initiative is a crucial part of India's journey towards becoming a knowledge-driven economy. 

The SUPER 30 scheme is not just about coaching. 

It is about creating opportunities and changing lives for the better. 

The program embodies the spirit of resilience and determination among students from disadvantaged backgrounds. 

The SUPER 30 initiative is a shining example of what can be achieved when education is made accessible to all. 

It is a powerful reminder of the importance of investing in human capital for the future of the nation. 

The scheme has become synonymous with hope and aspiration for many young minds across India. 

The SUPER 30 program continues to pave the way for a brighter future for countless students. 

It is a remarkable journey that showcases the potential of education to uplift lives and communities. 

The SUPER 30 scheme is a vital part of India's educational landscape. 

It emphasizes the need for inclusive policies that promote equal opportunities for all. 

The success of the SUPER 30 initiative is a collective achievement that involves students, educators, and supporters alike. 

It is a movement towards a more equitable and just society through the power of education.
